_note: Illustrative data showing the format; not a real teardown.
subtitle: Education · books · quiz funnel
verdict: A clean quiz and a model trial timeline, but the paywall forgets the goals and titles the quiz just collected, and closing it leads nowhere.

items.test: Headline the paywall with the chosen goals and the number of titles the user liked.
items.evidence: Flirt AI, answer-routed paywalls: +20% trial-to-paid (#22, directional, confounded)

items.test: Show one monthly-plan offer once when the onboarding paywall is closed.
items.evidence: Second chance after the onboarding paywall: premium conversion +25–30% (E2, directional)

items.test: Add a rating with volume above the trial timeline.
items.evidence: Runtastic, real review on the paywall: +44% paid subscriptions (#60, directional)

items.test: Let the user read one summary chapter after the taste test, before the paywall.
items.evidence: Survey + trial lesson: +25% trial starts, +78% ARPU (#12, directional)
